description: This file defines the AnnotationSourcer class, which extends ASM's AnnotationVisitor to generate Java source code representations of annotations during bytecode analysis.

classes.name: AnnotationSourcer
classes.description: A class that extends AnnotationVisitor to produce Java source code for annotations.

methods.name: AnnotationSourcer(Output output)
methods.description: Constructor initializing AnnotationSourcer with output and default array setting to false.

methods.name: AnnotationSourcer(Output output, boolean isArray)
methods.description: Constructor initializing AnnotationSourcer with output and configuration for array annotation formatting.

methods.name: visit(String name, Object value)
methods.description: Handles visiting a name-value pair within an annotation and writes it to the output.

methods.name: startOpen()
methods.description: Starts the annotation or array notation if not already started.

methods.name: visitEnd()
methods.description: Closes annotation or array notation and writes a newline.

methods.name: visitAnnotation(String name, String desc)
methods.description: Handles visiting an annotation within an annotation and writes the annotation's name.

methods.name: visitArray(String name)
methods.description: Prepares to visit an array annotation and returns a new AnnotationSourcer configured for array formatting.

methods.name: visitEnum(String name, String desc, String value)
methods.description: Placeholder for handling enum type annotation values, currently logs unsupported annotation enums.
